Context: Transport by rail:

## Transport by rail:  
- (a) By Passenger: Actual freight charged by the Railway.
- (b) By Goods: Cost of packing, cost of transporting the packed car, motor cycle to and from the goods-shed, cost of crating the car, loading and unloading charges, cost of ropes, etc., are all reimbursable. Claim to be limited to the amount under (a) above. - Note 3, SR 116 (a) I (iv).
